summary.text: Robert Anzalone is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 49 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Anzalone is a computer engineer who graduated from Springstead High School.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Robert Anzalone described himself as a husband and father who has spent his career solving problems and leading teams.
He named stronger public schools, better access to health care and mental health services, and an economy that works for working families as his priorities.
